text_block_list.text:
Race day. Wonder Acute reminisces about 
the Japan Dirt Derby, which was also held 
at Oi Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Speaking as if she had already retired... 
Without the venue's excitement ever 
reaching her heart, the race begins.
